content: Mihi Jesu mintaguk
Nai uŋaniŋ Lomahi’walaŋ mapme wapum Sisa Ogastas adi kwetkwet memetam hogohogok wohiye youkudip tiyemdok yoguk.
Kwiliniya adi Siliya kwetneŋ kiyap wapum hatilugukneŋ kwanai u tububihikiŋ.
Ala metam hogohogok adi yokwet mebihik hayemtauguk indigoŋ tuwot youkudip uŋoŋ tine ugiŋ.
Kaŋ Josep adi Dewit’walaŋ yalakiŋiŋ doktiŋa Dewit’walaŋ yokwet mebineŋ Betelehem uŋoŋ youkudip titiŋdok yoŋa yokwet wapum Nasalet biŋa Judiya kwetneŋ Betelehemde uguk.
Tiŋa tamŋiŋ gigit niŋgiŋ wou Maliya adigut wohik youkudip tide ugumuk. Wooŋ tamŋiŋ mihiwelenit
ala Betelehem uŋgoŋ mintadok nai tuguk.
Kaŋ nalum hekidi wooŋ iitdok yotmaaŋ u tuwot tokiguk doktiŋa mihiŋiŋ Tuwo mintaune hauledi yauneeŋ makau heki muwagehik nanaŋe nayagiŋ gineŋ kameu hakuk.
Aŋelo heki dompa yabudoko me heki gigit momooŋ yenimbihikiŋ
Kaŋ Betelehem yokwet gagayeŋ me noli dompa yabudokooŋ timiŋ damo mu deila hogok hakiŋ
kaŋ Wapum’walaŋ aŋelodi mintayembune Wapum’walaŋ hautadi yehitubu-hautaune munta kisaŋ tigiŋ.
Unduŋ tigiŋ kaŋ aŋelodi yeniŋguk, “Hidi munta mu tineŋ. Nu gigitmede momooŋ tihambulat. Metam hogohogok adi u nadiŋa nadifo wapum tineeŋ.
Kamiŋ Dewit’walaŋ yokwet mebineŋ hidi’walaŋ Tubuloda mehik, Wapum Kilisto mintalak.
Ala wooŋ eyaŋ hauledi tumula makau heki’walaŋ muwage gineŋ kameŋit kaŋ agaŋ uŋakoŋ yo nadineŋ.”
Unduŋ yenimbu pilap hinek kunum gineniŋ aŋelo mohok buŋa aŋelo nohik dut Bepaŋ indiŋ niutumbagiŋ.
Unduŋ toŋa aŋelo heki kotigoŋ kunum gineŋ loune me dompa yabudoko tigiŋ heki adi yogiŋ, “Indi Betelehemde wooŋ Wapumdi nemek ninilak u kane.”
Unduŋ yoŋa pilap hinek wooŋ Maliya dut Josep makau yotneŋ ikagumuk yabuŋa eyaŋ muwage gineŋ deihakuk u kagiŋ.
U kaŋ wooŋ aŋelodi eyaŋ wondok yeniŋguk u metam yenimbu
nadiŋa boho tigiŋ.
Unduŋ yeniŋgiŋ kaŋ Maliya adi mede u nadiŋa kaule mu tuguk, adi weleŋdi mede u nadituwatuwale hinek tuguk.
Kaŋ dompa yabudoko tagiŋ adi nemek aŋelodi yeniŋguk wendok tuwot buŋa kaŋ nadiŋa Bepaŋ niutumbaaŋ nintilooŋ udaneeŋ kotigoŋ dompa yabudokone ugiŋ.
Simion dut Ana adi mihi Jesu kagumuk
Mihi mintaaŋ halu melenai 8 dapmaune Judahi’walaŋ fek timiŋa wou koom miŋ weleŋ maaneŋ mu hatu aŋelodi yoguk uŋakoŋ, wou Jesu youkiŋ.
Moses’walaŋ Yodoko Mede hakuk uŋgoŋ takaliŋa yehitubu-walandadok nai tuguk, kaŋ Josep malam adi mihihik nagila Jelusalemde ugumuk.
Tiŋa undugoŋ Wapum’walaŋ Yodoko Mede gineŋ adi “Tuwo hogohogok mintaune Wapum siloŋ timindok,” youkiŋ wondoktiŋa nagila ugumuk.
Tiŋa Wapum’walaŋ Yodoko Mededi yolak unduŋ, butigili lufom be melebi lufom tuwaaŋ Bepaŋdok hemundumunduŋe tide ugumuk.
Nai uŋaniŋ Jelusalem uŋoŋ me niŋ hatiluguk wou Simion, adi me momooŋ tiŋa Bepaŋ nadisukilimiluguk, eŋ Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli adut hatiluguk, tiŋa adi Judahidi kedebadok nai wendok woomuluguk.
Doktiŋa indiŋ niŋguk, “Du hogok hatiŋa Wapumdi Kilisto kamewe yofafaŋe tuguk u buune kaŋ kumumbaaŋ.”
Nai uŋaniŋ Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi Simion nimbune Siloŋyotneŋ foguk. Kaŋ Jesu miŋbeu adi Wapum’walaŋ Yodoko Mededi yolak unduŋ tide fogumuk kaŋ
Simion adi mihi u toboŋa Bepaŋ indiŋ niutumbaguk.

content.text: “Wapum, du yofafaŋe medege kameeŋ hali bulaŋ ale tipilapilayege nu kulemaŋgoŋ napmeu wit.
Nu daunedi hinek tubuloda-me du’walaaniŋ agaŋ kalat,
u metam hogohogokdi kaneeŋ yoŋa kamelaŋ.
Uyadi metam Judahi’walaŋ feknit mokit adi’walaŋ welehik gineŋ hauta wapum mintawaak. Eŋ Isilae metam’walaŋkade wohogegigit wapum hinek mintawaak.”

content: Mede unduŋ yobu Jesu miŋbeu adi nadiune uŋgoniŋ hinek tuguk.

Simion adi mede unduŋ yoŋa kahaŋ tiyemiŋa Maliya indiŋ niŋguk, “Eyaŋ i Isilaehi metam nolidi adut galiŋa hatihati fofooŋ kahileneeŋ e metam noli adut mu galineeŋ adi kadaka tineeŋ yoŋa Bepaŋdi tubumintaguk. Tiŋa adi yadi Bepaŋ’walaaniŋ kudi niŋ uŋakoŋ
doktiŋa metamdi nehi uŋgoŋ aditok siweneŋ nadinadihik kabup hatak u miŋgoŋ tubumintaune bulaniŋgoŋdi subalige duŋgoŋ hinek tamat titobune nadiwaaŋ.”
Koom polofet tam niŋ hatiguk wou Ana, adi Fanuwe waabiŋiŋ, eŋ Asa’walaŋ yalakiŋiŋ. Adi koom tamkuya yali me tiŋa gulet 7 hatiŋa yohoi kumuŋguk.
Kaŋ tam kahat hatibu gulet 84 tuguk. Ala adi helemahelemaŋ Siloŋyotneŋ fooŋ Bepaŋ niutumbaaŋ nanaŋe kamehep tiŋa hati Bepaŋ ninadi kwanai tuluguk.

Ala nai uŋaniŋgoŋ Simion mede yolune Anadi maaŋ Siloŋyotneŋ fooŋ Josep malam yehitubu-mintaaŋ Bepaŋ niutumbaguk. Unduŋ tiŋa Jelusalemhi Tubulodahik kameu bubuŋdok woom hatiyagiŋ adi Jesu mihi mintagukdok gigitŋiŋ yeniŋguk.
Jelusalem uŋoŋ nemenemek Wapum’walaŋ Yodoko Mededi yolak u keleeŋ tubudapmaaŋ yohikwehineŋ Nasaletde ugiŋ.
Uŋoŋ hatiŋa mihi u agaŋ Bepaŋdi kahaŋ timimbune saŋiniŋnit bediŋa nadinadinit tuguk.
Gulet foloŋ mihi Jesu nagila Jelusalemde ugumuk
Gulet indigoŋ Jesu miŋbeu adi Aŋelodi Yabukiyondaaŋ Yalakapmegukdok hinamunide Jelusalemde yawagumuk.
Ala Jesu guletŋiŋ 12 tubune Aŋelodi Yabukiyondaaŋ Yalakapmeguk wendiniŋ gulet itne feŋ tagiŋ unduŋ Jelusalemde ugiŋ.
Gulet dapmaune Jesu adi uŋgoŋ hakuk kaŋ miŋbeu adi mu naditumbaaŋ yopmande ugumuk.
Adi metam noli dut wiiŋ yoŋa ugumuk ala hele kubugoŋ dapmaune mehimehiye gineŋ lohigumuk
iŋgoŋ mu kaŋ kotigoŋ Jelusalemde lohitaugumuk.
Wooŋ lohi hatibune kadehati lufomkulitniŋ dapmaune Siloŋyotneŋ looŋ kalune Jesu adi Judahi Yodoko Mede hinale heki’walaŋ lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ ila medehik nadiŋa yeninadi tuguk.
Kaŋ me noli adi Jesudi mede tubu-udaneyemguk u kaŋ nadiune beweniŋgoŋ hinek tuguk.
Unduŋ ha-tulu miŋbeu adi maaŋ wooŋ kaŋ boho tiŋa miŋdi niŋguk, “Mihine, du maŋgoŋde nilamulune baha indi nadibedi kisaŋ hinek tiŋa golohiyamut?”
Unduŋ nimbu adibo yeniŋguk, “Hidi maŋgoŋde nolohiyamuk? Nu batnedi kwanai indiŋ titiŋdegoŋ nanindapmaguk u hidi mube nadiyamuk?”
Mede u yeniŋguk uyadi mu nadidakalegumuk.

Tiŋa kotigoŋ noŋgoŋ Nasaletde ugiŋ, wooŋ hatiŋa Jesudi miŋbeu’walaŋ mede tiloloŋ kwanai tiyemiluguk. Miŋ adi nemenemek uŋoŋ mintaguk u kaŋ wooŋ kaule mu tuguk, u weleŋ gineŋ nadiŋale nadiŋale hatiluguk.
Kaŋ Jesu adi weleŋ be folooŋ wanaŋ saŋiniŋnit bediguk. Kaŋ me be Bepaŋ adi kaune utumba hogok tuluguk.
